{{Quote|About 1,500 years ago, the ''Sayings'' were printed in a small run for the Atrisian nobility to marvel over (a ploy by the Atrisian Emperor to display the superiority of his noted ancestor, and by extension himself).|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}} establishes that the [[Atrisian Emperor/Legends|Atrisian Emperor]] who made the ''[[Sayings]]'' available to the general public was an [[Atrisian]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes to have been [[Human/Legends|Humans]].</ref> '''male''' served as the [[Atrisian Emperor/Legends|Atrisian Emperor]] approximately 1,500 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to<ref name="Files" /> [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="11 ABY">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}, which mentions the [[Atrisian Emperor/Legends|Atrisian Emperor]], is set shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final defeat]] of the resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].</ref>
